characterDescription: Blodwen Balchder, the young woman EXACTLY as in the reference: youthful oval face, warm fair skin, large grey-blue eyes, auburn brown side-swept hair in one thick braid over HER RIGHT shoulder (viewer's LEFT), same loose side locks. Same square-necked black long-sleeved medieval dress with muted gold curling floral embroidery on bodice and cuffs, same small oval gold medallion at center neckline. Preserve her youthful face, age, hairstyle and proportions; no new jewelry.

panels.gesture: Gesenkter Blick, hängende Schultern, locker verschränkte Hände.
panels.generationDirection: Quiet sadness: downcast eyes, downturned closed mouth, drooping shoulders, hands loosely clasped low before torso; no tears.

panels.gesture: Tränen, bebender Mund, Hand wischt Wange, andere am eigenen Oberarm.
panels.generationDirection: Tearful distress: tears on cheeks, trembling mouth, one hand wiping a cheek, other gently grasping own upper arm.

panels.gesture: Weite besorgte Augen, hochgezogene Schultern, schützende offene Hand.
panels.generationDirection: Fear: wide worried eyes, brows raised inward, shoulders drawn up, one protective open palm before torso, other hand close to collarbone.

panels.gesture: Errötete Wangen, Blick zur Seite, Hand reibt Nacken.
panels.generationDirection: Shy embarrassment: gently flushed cheeks, averted gaze, awkward small smile, one hand rubbing back of neck, tucked shoulders; innocent age-appropriate emotion.

panels.gesture: Wissendes Grinsen, Hand seitlich am Mund, vertrauliche Kopfneigung.
panels.generationDirection: Mischievous whisper: small knowing grin, sideways gaze, one hand cupped beside mouth, head leaning in as if sharing a harmless secret.

panels.gesture: Rufender offener Mund, Hand als Schalltrichter, andere offen erhoben.
panels.generationDirection: Calling out: mouth open announcing, one hand cupped beside mouth, other open hand extended at shoulder height to get attention; energetic, not angry.

panels.gesture: Schwere Lider, zusammengesunken, Hand reibt Schläfe.
panels.generationDirection: Exhaustion: heavy eyelids, small tired sigh, slumped posture, one hand rubbing temple, other arm relaxed.

panels.gesture: Kinn etwas erhoben, zufriedenes Grinsen, Hand an Hüfte, kleine Präsentiergeste.
panels.generationDirection: Proud satisfaction: upright chest, slightly raised chin, satisfied asymmetric smile, one hand at hip, other in a small open-palmed presenting gesture.

panels.gesture: Ratloser Blick, schiefer Mund, beide Handflächen hoch im Achselzucken.
panels.generationDirection: Uncertain shrug: uneven lifted brows, crooked uncertain mouth, both palms up in a clear shrug, shoulders raised.
